work.permit: Labour inspector's consent (minor entered in the employment register five working days before starting)

note: The lead set the service's months to null on 2026-10-31: the source gives 8 months for most and 11 for leaders and specialists, two lengths, as Finland's are held. Majority: the General Part of the Civil Code Act sets the age of full active legal capacity; its text wasn't reached (Riigi Teataja's search sits behind a Cloudflare challenge, which was not passed), so the age of 18 is read from the Labour Inspectorate's page, which says the contract of a person under 18 must be approved by a legal representative. Emancipation by marriage or a court's extension of capacity isn't held. Work: Employment Contracts Act (passed 17.12.2008, RT I 2009, 5, 35, in force 01.07.2009), § 7, read in the English translation in force 15.06.2024 to 31.08.2025 (the later consolidated text wasn't reached): no employment contract with a minor under 15 or one still subject to compulsory schooling; light work from 13 (and 15 to 16 while at school); minors of 7 to 12 may do light work in culture, art, sports or advertising. The Labour Inspectorate's page (Tööelu, updated 13.07.2026) says no separate permission is applied for since that date: the employer enters the 7 to 12-year-old in the employment register five working days before the work starts, with the legal representative's consent, and the inspector may refuse within five working days; under 7, no work. A legal representative's consent is needed for every minor (§ 8); hours limits for minors aren't held. Service: the Defence Resources Agency says male citizens are liable from 18 and must enter conscription between 18 and 27; the term is 8 months (October intake, most soldiers) or 11 months (January and July intakes, leaders and specialists), held here as 8. Women may enter conscription voluntarily. Registration at 17 isn't held.

sources.title: Riigi Teataja, Employment Contracts Act (English translation, in force 15.06.2024 to 31.08.2025)
sources.said: An employer must not enter into an employment contract with a minor under 15 years of age or a minor subject to the obligation to attend school ... Minors of 7–12 years of age are allowed to do light work in the field of culture, art, sports or advertising.

sources.title: Labour Inspectorate (Tööelu), Recruitment of minors (updated 13.07.2026)
sources.said: Children under the age of 7 are prohibited from working pursuant to the Employment Contracts Act. ... When employing a minor of 7–12 years of age, the employer shall enter the following information in the self-service of the Labour Inspectorate five working days before the minor commences work

sources.title: Labour Inspectorate, Recruiting a minor
sources.said: Therefore, the contract of a young person under the age of 18 must be approved by the parent or other legal representative.

sources.title: Defence Resources Agency, Conscription
sources.said: When you turn 18, male Estonian citizens become liable for military service ... between the ages of 18 and 27 you must enter conscription ... Women who are Estonian citizens, aged 18–27 and with at least a basic education, have the opportunity to voluntarily enter conscription.

sources.title: Defence Resources Agency, About entering conscription
sources.said: Leaders and specialists in January and July – DURATION 11 MONTHS Soldiers in October – DURATION 8 MONTHS
